purpose: Exploratory GPU extensions of Kingsley Ukandu's GP, run after the frozen CPU study (configs/gp_study.json) and kept separate from it. Every choice uses validation fold (f+1)%5 only; the frozen selection is not revisited.

selection.metric: pooled validation MSE, each cell at its selected family (lowest validation RMSE), exact predictor
selection.production: the selected F0 and F2 variants on all five folds, with test and validation predictions

order: demo on one cell (A2058, study fold) and a direct-likelihood check of the replicate collapse; then coverage and features; then select; then production
